data.name: S_kubuno_Description
data.value: Rust and Kubuno views development in Visual Studio.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_Description
data.value: rust-analyzer, editor features and inline hints for .rs files.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_diagnostics_Description
data.value: Logging of the Rust language server.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_Description
data.value: The grey hints rust-analyzer adds inside the code (types, parameter names...), like C#'s inline hints.

data.name: S_kubuno_debugging_Description
data.value: Debugging of Rust and Kubuno applications.

data.name: S_kubuno_data_Description
data.value: The Data Explorer and its query windows.

data.name: S_kubuno_data_explorer_Description
data.value: Connections, schema tree and table data.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_Description
data.value: The Linux machine that holds the development database (through an SSH tunnel) and, later, the Linux builds.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_Description
data.value: How Kubuno connects to the host: non-interactive SSH with a dedicated key, never a password.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_devDatabase_Description
data.value: The SSH tunnel the Kubuno Core launch profiles open to the host's PostgreSQL.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_rustAnalyzer_pathOverride_Description
data.value: Full path to rust-analyzer.exe. When empty, Kubuno tries "rustup which rust-analyzer", then %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin\rust-analyzer.exe, then the PATH environment variable. Applies the next time the server starts.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_editor_formatOnSave_Description
data.value: Run Format Document (rustfmt, through rust-analyzer) on every .rs file before it is saved.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_editor_codeLens_Description
data.value: Show reference and implementation counts ("3 references") above Rust items, like C#'s CodeLens. Click a count to open Find All References or the implementations.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_diagnostics_lspTrace_Description
data.value: How much of the traffic between Visual Studio and rust-analyzer is logged in the Kubuno Output pane. Off logs only the startup line and errors; Messages adds one line per request and response; Verbose adds the raw JSON.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_show_Description
data.value: When the hints are shown in .rs files. "While pressing Alt+F1" is C#'s default (hold Alt+F1 to see them); "Visual Studio setting" follows Text Editor > All Languages > Inlay Hints. Which hints exist is chosen below.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_parameterNames_enabled_Description
data.value: Show the parameter's name before each argument ("title: name"). rust-analyzer already leaves the hint out when the argument is named like the parameter.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_parameterNames_forLiterals_Description
data.value: Keep the parameter name hint when the argument is a literal (5, "text", true, 'c').

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_parameterNames_forOtherArguments_Description
data.value: Keep the parameter name hint when the argument is a variable, a call or any other expression that is not a literal.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_enabled_Description
data.value: Show the inferred type after a variable (": Vec<u8>").

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_hideApparent_Title
data.value: Suppress hints when the type is apparent

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_hideApparent_Description
data.value: No type hint when the initializer names the type (let w = Widget::new()).

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_hideClosureVariables_Title
data.value: Suppress hints on variables holding a closure

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_hideClosureVariables_Description
data.value: No type hint on a variable initialized with a closure (let f = |x| x + 1): the closure's own type is unreadable noise.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_closureParameters_Title
data.value: Show hints for closure parameter types

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_types_closureParameters_Description
data.value: Show the type of a closure's parameters, like C#'s lambda parameter types.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_methodChains_Title
data.value: Show types at the end of method chains

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_methodChains_Description
data.value: Show the type at the end of each line of a method chain.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_closureReturnTypes_Description
data.value: Show a closure's return type: never, only when its body is a block, or always.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_closureReturnTypes_Item_withBlock
data.value: Only for closures with a block

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_lifetimeElision_Description
data.value: Show the lifetimes Rust infers in signatures (fn f<'a>(x: &'a T) -> &'a U): never, skipping the trivial ones, or always.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_bindingModes_Description
data.value: Show the implicit & and ref of patterns matched through a reference.

data.name: S_kubuno_rust_inlayHints_other_closingBraces_Description
data.value: Show the name of the item after the closing brace of a long block ("// fn main").

data.name: S_kubuno_views_languageServer_pathOverride_Description
data.value: Full path to kubuno-views-ls.exe. When empty, Kubuno tries the extension's own tools folder, then the PATH environment variable, then the local development build folders.

data.name: S_kubuno_designer_editor_useAsDefault_Title
data.value: Use the View Designer as the default editor

data.name: S_kubuno_designer_editor_useAsDefault_Description
data.value: A double-click on a .kbview file opens the Kubuno View Designer (Design | XML split view) instead of the plain XML editor. Either way the designer is reachable through Open With.

data.name: S_kubuno_designer_surface_showDesignOutlines_Description
data.value: Draws a faint dashed outline around the containers that are otherwise invisible (a Panel or Stack with no surface, border or background), so they can be found and dropped into, like the dotted border Windows Forms shows around a borderless Panel. Controls always look exactly as at run time. Applies to the designers opened afterwards.

data.name: S_kubuno_debugging_justMyCode_frameworkIsExternalCode_Title
data.value: Treat the Kubuno framework as external code

data.name: S_kubuno_debugging_justMyCode_frameworkIsExternalCode_Description
data.value: Like Windows Forms for a C# application: with Just My Code on, the Call Stack collapses the Kubuno framework (kubuno_desktop_views, kubuno_desktop_controls, kubuno_desktop_ui, the event-handler dispatch glue) into [External Code] and Step Into (F11) goes straight to your handlers. Turn it off to see and debug Kubuno's own code. The Rust standard library is always stepped over. Takes effect at the next debug session.

data.name: S_kubuno_data_explorer_showDataRows_Title
data.value: Rows shown by Show Table Data

data.name: S_kubuno_data_explorer_showDataRows_Description
data.value: How many rows "Show Table Data" reads from a table or view (1 to 100000).

data.name: S_kubuno_data_explorer_defaultCredentialStore_Description
data.value: Where the Add Connection dialog proposes to store a new connection string. Either way the string is never written into a project.

data.name: S_kubuno_data_query_maxRows_Description
data.value: A result set is cut after this many rows; the status bar of the query window says so (1 to 1000000).

data.name: S_kubuno_data_query_timeoutSeconds_Description
data.value: How long a query may run before it is cancelled (1 to 86400).

data.name: S_kubuno_data_diagnostics_logRequests_Description
data.value: Log each request to kubuno-data-tool (method and parameters, with connection strings, passwords and SQL text removed) in the Kubuno Output pane.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_host_Description
data.value: Name or IP address of the remote Linux host.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_user_Description
data.value: The account Kubuno connects as. Its ~/.ssh/authorized_keys must hold the public key (the .pub file next to the private key).

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_port_Description
data.value: The port of the host's SSH server (1 to 65535).

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_privateKeyPath_Description
data.value: The private key Kubuno authenticates with, used by Windows' OpenSSH in batch mode: it must have no passphrase, since Kubuno never asks for a password or a passphrase. Environment variables (%USERPROFILE%) are expanded.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_connection_knownHostsPath_Description
data.value: The host keys Kubuno accepts, kept apart from your own known_hosts. An unknown host is never accepted silently: an info bar shows its fingerprint and adds it here only when you click Accept.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_devDatabase_tunnel_Description
data.value: When F5 / Ctrl+F5 of the Kubuno Core profiles opens the tunnel from localhost to the host's PostgreSQL (ssh -N -L). It is reused by the next launches and closed with Visual Studio; errors appear in an info bar and the Kubuno Output pane.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_devDatabase_tunnel_Item_auto
data.value: When KUBUNO_DEV_DATABASE_URL points at the local port

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_devDatabase_localPort_Description
data.value: The tunnel's local end: KUBUNO_DEV_DATABASE_URL then reads postgres://kubuno:<password>@localhost:55432/kubuno_dev.

data.name: S_kubuno_remote_devDatabase_remotePort_Description
data.value: The port PostgreSQL listens on, on the host's own loopback (it does not need to be reachable from the network).
